modules.overview: Variables store data and data types define value categories.

topics.title: Variables
topics.description: A Python variable is a reserved memory location to store values. In other words, a variable in a python program gives data to the computer for processing.
rules: Variable names cannot start with numbers
Keywords cannot be used as variable names

topics.title: Arithmetic Operators
topics.description: Arithmetic operators are used with numeric values to perform common mathematical operations such as addition, subtraction, etc.

topics.title: If Statement
topics.description: An 'if statement' is written by using the if keyword. It evaluates a condition and executes code if the condition is true.

topics.title: Loops
topics.description: Python has two primitive loop commands: 'while' loops and 'for' loops. Loops are used for iterating over a sequence.

forLoop.description: A for loop is used for iterating over a sequence (that is either a list, a tuple, a dictionary, a set, or a string).

whileLoop.description: With the while loop we can execute a set of statements as long as a condition is true.

topics.title: Function Declaration
topics.description: A function is a block of code which only runs when it is called. You can pass data, known as parameters, into a function.

example.code:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

topics.title: Classes and Objects
topics.description: Python is an object-oriented programming language. Almost everything in Python is an object, with its properties and methods.

topics.title: Django
topics.description: Powerful web framework for enterprise applications.

projects.name: Calculator App
projects.description: A beginner Python project that performs addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulus, and power operations. It teaches input handling, type conversion, functions, and condition checking.

features.name: Menu Driven Flow
features.explanation: The user chooses an operation from a numbered menu.

features.name: Input Validation
features.explanation: The program checks whether numbers are valid and avoids division by zero.

features.name: Reusable Functions
features.explanation: Each arithmetic operation can be written as a separate function.

steps: Read two numbers from the user

example.code:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

num1 = float(input("Enter first number: "))
num2 = float(input("Enter second number: "))
print("Total:", add(num1, num2))

projects.name: Student Management System
projects.description: A practical CRUD project for storing and managing student details. It helps students learn lists, dictionaries, functions, loops, file handling, and search logic.

features.name: Add Student
features.explanation: Store roll number, name, department, and mark.

features.name: View All Students
features.explanation: Loop through records and display them in a clean format.

features.name: Search Student
features.explanation: Find a record using roll number or name.

features.name: Save to File
features.explanation: Use JSON or CSV so the data remains after closing the program.

example.code:
students = []

students.append({"roll": 1, "name": "Arun", "mark": 92})
for student in students:
    print(student["roll"], student["name"], student["mark"])

projects.name: Weather App
projects.description: A Python API project that fetches weather data from an online service and displays temperature, humidity, wind speed, and condition. It teaches HTTP requests, JSON parsing, and error handling.

features.name: API Request
features.explanation: Send a request to a weather API endpoint using a city name.

features.name: JSON Response
features.explanation: Read the API response and extract only the required fields.

features.name: Error Handling
features.explanation: Show a friendly message when city name or internet connection fails.

example.code:
import requests

city = "Chennai"
url = f"https://api.example.com/weather?city={city}"
response = requests.get(url)
print(response.json())

projects.name: Chat Application
projects.description: A real-time communication project that can be built using sockets or a web framework. It teaches client-server architecture, message events, rooms, and user state.

features.name: Send Message
features.explanation: A user types a message and sends it to the server.

features.name: Receive Message
features.explanation: Connected users receive new messages without refreshing.

features.name: Chat Room
features.explanation: Messages can be grouped by room or channel.

projects.name: Machine Learning Prediction System
projects.description: An applied machine learning project where the program trains a model from data and predicts an output. Students can build marks prediction, house price prediction, or placement chance prediction.

features.name: Dataset Loading
features.explanation: Read CSV data using pandas.

features.name: Data Cleaning
features.explanation: Handle missing values and select useful columns.

features.name: Model Training
features.explanation: Train a regression or classification model using scikit-learn.

features.name: Prediction
features.explanation: Give new input and generate predicted output.

example.code:
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

model = LinearRegression()
model.fit([[1], [2], [3]], [40, 50, 60])
print(model.predict([[4]]))
